conformance_boundary: Each status records a static source review. A bounded or refused row establishes neither Vulkan conformance nor RS485M execution. A conformance claim requires an executed CTS result with the source, ICD, and target identity retained.

statuses.bounded: The source exposes an explicitly bounded path. The row names the audit or focused test that can falsify the stated boundary.
statuses.refused: The source withholds or fail closes the category outside a named executing subset. The row does not call the category implemented.
statuses.unassessed: The registry category has an API definition but this review records no source-level implementation claim for it.

rows.falsifier: Change the loader entry point or the reported API version without updating the entrypoint audit and the advertised-surface audit.
Advertise an extension or feature whose driver route the advertised-surface audit cannot name.
Make a queue submission reach DRM without the exact arming and retention gate, or return success after an unrecorded command buffer.
Admit an allocation, map, flush, invalidate, or bind outside the one-BO and admitted-image contracts without extending the focused memory tests.

requirement_blocks: Sparse resource memory management API commands
rows.falsifier: Expose sparse requirements or accept vkQueueBindSparse without a native sparse-memory route and a new tracker review.
Return success from a synchronization or query operation whose object state cannot reach completion or whose result has no defined producer.
Expand image or buffer admission beyond the executed family, or let a buffer-view request report success after the fail-closed entrypoint audit classifies it as unsupported.
Admit a shader, descriptor, sampler, or pipeline shape that lacks a native lowering route and a focused positive and refusal test.
Permit a render-pass or command-buffer lifetime transition that leaves a public command buffer executable without a defined native state carrier.
Allow a core vkCmd entry point outside the qualified draw, transfer, clear, or experimental compute subsets to succeed without recording executable work.

requirement_blocks: Types not directly used by the API. Include e.g. structs that are not parameter types of commands, but still defined by the API.
rows.falsifier: Claim coverage for an auxiliary core type without a source path, a matching command contract, and a focused test.
